scenes.prompt: Medium shot from the rear preparation doorway of an unbranded later Japanese sushi restaurant, an anonymous chef holding one finished plain plate at frame left while distant guest seats wait across a broad open floor at frame right, uncertain face, soft indoor light, blank decor.
scenes.why: 開場問後場盤子如何到客席，只看得見待送的盤和兩處空間；直線解法留給 T04 回收。

scenes.prompt: High-angle shot inside a later unbranded Japanese sushi dining room, one anonymous operator holding a plain plate between a curved guest counter and a distant rear kitchen doorway, looking across the open floor with a questioning expression, bright window light.
scenes.why: T03 還在問是否一定要繞著吧台；不讓手勢提前畫出直線，等 T04 才見送盤方向。

scenes.prompt: Medium shot inside an undated unbranded Japanese sushi dining room, one anonymous chef facing a row of waiting diners across a small circular counter, his eyes on a single unserved plate, gentle overhead light.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot in an undated unbranded Japanese sushi dining room, one anonymous diner reaching toward a plate arriving along a straight conveyor from a distant rear kitchen opening, plate and hand in clear focus, mild window light.
scenes.why: T04 已公布後場直線答案，保留客人接盤的回收畫面，只拿掉未證的 1970 年代。

scenes.why: T03 明說警告與後來其他店不是單一開關；移除信封在前、開店在後的視覺因果箭頭。
